lines.1: 「Leo, I brought you some tea. How is the studying going?」
lines.6: 「Good grief. Are you the type who needs someone watching him?」
lines.7: 「Then I'll stay here. Continue your studies.」
lines.9: 「Don't mind me. I'll quietly do some push-ups.」
lines.10: 「One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.」
lines.12: 「No guts and no concentration either, huh?」
lines.13: Otome strode out of the room.
lines.14: She really was full of energy.
lines.15: But somehow, I felt brighter too.
lines.16: Maybe she had shared some of that energy with me.
